hints.title: Single Character Outlier Identification
hints.text: Every original character appears in the augmented string, except for exactly one extra character that was appended and shuffled. How can cancelling matching characters reveal the outlier?

hints.title: Self Cancelling XOR Parity
hints.text: A bitwise operation that evaluates to zero for duplicate character codes cancels out all matched character pairs when applied across both strings.

hints.title: Cumulative Character XOR Accumulation
hints.text: Initialize an integer accumulator to zero. Iterate over all character codes in the first string and combine them using bitwise exclusive or. Continue combining character codes from the second string. The remaining integer value converts back to the added character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting both strings takes O(N log N) time, while frequency counting tables allocate additional memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise XOR achieves optimal O(N) runtime and true O(1) space by canceling identical pairs without extra storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should mention the XOR cancellation property or character sum difference approach and analyze its space efficiency.
